dataset.name: ann-benchmarks deep-image-96-angular
dataset.truth: provided neighbors (top-100 by angular distance); event uses first 10

implementation.note: mirrors the registered 100K/1M build configuration; variation attributable to seed x order

query_roles.sampling: numpy RandomState(991).choice over the test split

event_semantics.quality: hit_count >= 10 of 10 against provided truth top-10
event_semantics.min_safe_action: B(q) = min ef with hit_count >= 10; BOT if none
event_semantics.note: h=8/9 sensitivity recomputed later from recorded hit counts (no new searches)

metrics_preregistered: finite-action variation; endpoint variation; unresolved mass
incremental transport risk (Eq.20 caliber: transported minus target-bottom reference, mean over all directed pairs) + query-bootstrap 95% CI (5000 reps, seed 991)
max-over-source pooling k-curve for k in 1..7 (30 draws, seed 991)
single-thread build times; byte-identity of the two identity builds
storage_protocol: hdf5 retained (3.85GB); each index deleted immediately after its searches are recorded; peak disk ~9.5GB of 15GB free
stop_rules: halt if query/base overlap > 0, if any build errors twice, or if free disk < 3GB; no grid or role change after first search
analysis_blinding: risk computed only after all 8 builds complete
